dix_gex.meaning: DIX = dark-pool buy/sell imbalance (retail-ish demand); GEX = modelled dealer gamma in $bn per 1% move
dix_gex.caveat: GEX assumes dealers long calls / short puts from OI only; sign can be wrong in unusual flow. DIX is a share of off-exchange volume, not a dollar flow.

ofr_fsi.meaning: 0 = normal; >0 = above-average stress. Sub-indices separate credit / equity valuation / safe assets / funding / volatility
ofr_fsi.caveat: Weekly-ish publication lag; rescaled so history has zero mean.

epu_us.meaning: News-based count of articles about policy uncertainty, monthly, 1985→. A text-based risk measure that is genuinely independent of price data
epu_us.caveat: Monthly, published with a lag of days; the index is normalised to 100 = 1985-2009 mean.

gpr.meaning: GPR / GPRC (threats) / GPRA (acts) — newspaper-based geopolitical risk, 1900→ for some series
gpr.caveat: Monthly and slow-moving; good as a regime backdrop, not a trading trigger.

eia_crude_stocks_w.meaning: Weekly physical inventory / spot price — the actual supply side behind energy futures
eia_crude_stocks_w.caveat: Published Wednesday 10:30 ET for crude; the release is the event, the level is the context.

eia_henryhub_w.meaning: Weekly physical inventory / spot price — the actual supply side behind energy futures
eia_henryhub_w.caveat: Published Wednesday 10:30 ET for crude; the release is the event, the level is the context.

okx_btc_funding.meaning: 8-hourly perpetual funding = the price of leveraged long exposure; positive = longs pay shorts (crowded long). A carry + crowding measure in one number
okx_btc_funding.caveat: OKX only (one venue), 100 most recent points per call → build history by polling.

okx_btc_lsr.meaning: Accounts with net long vs net short positions (retail-leaning). >1 = crowd is long
okx_btc_lsr.caveat: Account-count ratio, not notional; classic contrarian input with weak standalone power.

deribit_btc_iv.meaning: Full BTC option chain: mark IV per strike/expiry → risk reversal (25d put IV − call IV) is the purest fear gauge in a 24/7 market; term structure inverts in stress
deribit_btc_iv.caveat: A snapshot, not history. Mark IV is venue-published, not a tradeable quote; OI is per-contract.
